articles.title: Denso Corp's Dividend Analysis
articles.summary: Denso Corp (DNZOF) recently announced a total dividend of $0.23 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-29. This amount consists entirely of a $0.23 per share cash dividend. While the payable date is currently listed as not applicable in our dataset, income-focused investors should note the ex-dividend date carefully, as shareholders must own the stock before that date to qualify for the payment.
